reference_text: Good morning and welcome to Limbach Holdings earnings conference call. Speaking today is CEO Mike McCann and CFO Jay Sharp. We are pleased to announce quarterly revenue of 135.2 million, expanding our gross margin to 24.5 percent. Owner-direct revenue reached 62 percent of total revenue, generating free cash flow of 14.1 million. We will now open the line for analyst questions. First question comes from Rob Brown with Lake Street Capital Markets. Mike, could you provide more detail on owner-direct revenue growth and customer retention? Owner-direct relationships expanded to 62 percent of total revenue, driving higher gross margins. Our next question comes from Gerry Sweeney with ROTH MKM. How does the acquisition pipeline look for expanding specialized mechanical services? We continue to evaluate accretive tuck-in acquisitions that enhance our recurring maintenance profile. Our next question comes from Brent Thielman with D.A. Davidson. What is your outlook for data center and industrial project demand? Demand from mission-critical facilities remains very healthy across our primary geographies.
